speaker: AIDEN
text: The night I met Shawna, I had cocaine on my shirt and another man's blood inside my watch. Nigga, inside. I could wash the shirt. Every time I checked the hour, the watch reminded me I needed to apologize to somebody or finish the job.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I was twenty-four. My last car had burned outside my ex-boyfriend's apartment. He still thought that meant I wanted him back. Before sunrise I would steal three million dollars, leave with a woman every killer in Vegas wanted, and catch a bullet that would stay in me for the rest of my life.

speaker: AIDEN
text: First, twelve niggas wanted to beat my ass behind a nightclub.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Big T led me out while the bass was shaking the exit door. Blue rags, gold chains, cars parked crooked. I knew some of the faces. Niggas who borrowed ten dollars with both hands now stood there warming up to break something I needed.

speaker: AIDEN
text: T squeezed my shoulder.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "Once a nigga in, that nigga in. Understand?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, I understand."

speaker: BIG_T
text: "Summer ends, a body drops, suddenly a nigga got somewhere else to be."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "I got nowhere else to be. That's why I'm standing here instead of enjoying the fucking music."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Somebody laughed. T didn't.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "You think this funny?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, I think twelve is a committee. Which one of you takes the minutes?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: He hit me against a Cadillac.

speaker: AIDEN
text: That answered it. T took the minutes.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Then the other eleven arrived with amendments.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I caught a fist in the mouth and an elbow behind my ear. Somebody kicked my leg out. Concrete scraped my palms. I got up with blood in one eye and swung at whatever the good eye could find. Nigga, I wanted in. I wanted somewhere to put my name where a motherfucker wouldn't cross it out when I left the room.

speaker: B01C02_CREW_MEMBER_1
text: "Stay down,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: somebody said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, y'all just told me to stay IN. Pick an instruction."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank came under my guard and hit me in the ribs. Twenty-eight, twice my size, a big nigga with a shirt that had already lost its argument with his shoulders. I grabbed that shirt and drove him into another car. The alarm went off.

speaker: B01C02_CREW_MEMBER_2
text: "Not the paint!"

speaker: AIDEN
text: somebody shouted.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, you should've thought about the paint before you started throwing people at it!"

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank tried to turn me. I kept hitting him.

speaker: TANK
text: "Get this nigga off me!"

speaker: AIDEN
text: Big T laughed. Nobody helped. Tank looked past my shoulder, betrayed by eleven niggas and an alarm manufacturer.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "You said he was little."

speaker: TANK
text: "Nigga, I have new information!"

speaker: AIDEN
text: T pulled me away before Tank could kill me for making him say that. I stood with my fists up, shaking so hard I couldn't open them.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "Enough,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: T said.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "Twelve niggas. Look at him. Still shopping."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, I'm done,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I said.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "You sure?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "I'm waiting for my hands to hear it."

speaker: AIDEN
text: He took a gold chain from his pocket and lowered it over my head. A little cross settled against my chest. The niggas around us stopped grinning.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "My brother wore that,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: he said.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "Real nigga."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I looked up.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Where my nigga at, then? I should thank him."

speaker: BIG_T
text: "Dead."

speaker: AIDEN
text: The car alarm finally stopped. I could hear T breathing.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "Nigga, don't make me bury you too."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I closed my hand around the cross. A minute earlier he'd been punching me. Now I was standing there trying not to cry because this motherfucker had found a way to call me family.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Not this nigga,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: He kissed my forehead and pointed toward the club.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "Come get your money. Niggas, make room for my son."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank held the door. I tried to help him with it.

speaker: TANK
text: "Nigga, walk through,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: he said.

speaker: TANK
text: "I can still defeat a door."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I walked through.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Inside, everything was blue light and smoke. The back room was packed with niggas counting stacks of cash. Bricks of cocaine covered a glass table. Bottles of Hennessy stood between them. Three women in diamonds were drinking with a man who had two pistols tucked into the same belt. One of them lifted her glass when she saw my face.

speaker: B01C02_DIAMOND_WOMAN_1
text: "Damn, baby. You survive a war?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Yeah,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "And I won."

speaker: AIDEN
text: They cheered. Somebody pushed a bottle into my hand. Somebody else handed me a blunt already burning. I drank, smoked, wiped the blood off my lip, and sat down beside a pile of money bigger than anything I had ever seen in my life.

speaker: B01C02_DIAMOND_WOMAN_2
text: "This the nigga beat Tank?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: one of the women asked.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "That's the nigga,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: T said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She pushed a folded bill into my shirt pocket. A thousand dollars. I'd been back inside for ninety seconds and a woman was paying me to be handsome with a broken face. That's the kind of night it was.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank came in carrying a bag of ice against his jaw. He took the bottle out my hand, drank, and gave it back.

speaker: TANK
text: "Nigga, who taught you to fight dirty like that?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Same nigga taught you to fight unconscious."

speaker: AIDEN
text: The room went crazy. Tank stared at me long enough I thought we was going again. Then that big nigga started laughing too, blood on his teeth, and pulled a chair up beside mine. We drank from the same bottle. I would've trusted him to hold my heart while I fought with both hands.

speaker: AIDEN
text: T threw me the keys to a black Mercedes.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "That's yours."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I looked at the keys.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, these keys real? You serious?"

speaker: BIG_T
text: "West side need a nigga. West side got you."

speaker: AIDEN
text: An hour earlier I hadn't even been in the crew. Now the west side was mine. That's how fast life moved when you were ready for it. Some men spent their whole lives waiting on a chance. I took mine with blood still coming out of my mouth.

speaker: AIDEN
text: T opened a photograph on his phone.

speaker: AIDEN
text: A woman stood beside a swimming pool at night. Black dress. Diamond earrings. Dark hair over one shoulder. She wasn't smiling. Behind her, the whole Strip was lit up, but I was looking at her.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "Shawna,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: T said.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "Twenty-six. Works for Red."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, working for Red doing what?"

speaker: BIG_T
text: "Whatever Red wants."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank watched me from across the table.

speaker: AIDEN
text: T kept talking.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "She's at the Saint tonight. Penthouse. She's bringing a case down at eleven. You take her and the money to my house in Henderson. That's all you gotta do."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Why she leaving him?"

speaker: BIG_T
text: "Because she finally got smart."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I looked at the picture again.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, does Red know about this little family pickup?"

speaker: BIG_T
text: "If he knew, we wouldn't be having this conversation."

speaker: AIDEN
text: T gripped the back of my neck and pulled me close enough that nobody else could hear.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "Don't fall in love with her."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I laughed.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "I'm serious. Look at me."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, look at me. Do I look like the nigga falls in love?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: He let go of me.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I believed that shit when I said it. Nigga, remember that. I meant it with my entire chest.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The Saint had a gold fountain outside and bulletproof glass on the top floor. Red owned the penthouse, the nightclub underneath it, and enough people in the building that nobody asked questions when his men dragged somebody into a service elevator. Nigga had built himself a palace where the carpets could swallow a scream.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I parked the Mercedes right in front.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The valet looked at the blood drying on my collar.

speaker: B01C02_VALET
text: "You need somebody to call a doctor?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, my car needs you first. Nothing happens to it."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I gave him a hundred and went inside.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Upstairs, the penthouse was going crazy. Music pounding. Cocaine all over the tables. Niggas gambling with money that was still wrapped from the bank. Hookers in dresses that cost more than the cars outside, laughing with men who never gave their real names. Everybody was rich. Everybody was armed. Every nigga thought the night belonged to him.

speaker: AIDEN
text: A man in a white fur coat was doing coke off a trophy. It was September in Vegas. I didn't know what the trophy was for, but that nigga had brought it with him and was guarding it like the whole room wanted his championship.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I knew a woman by the bar, Mercedes, thirty, who had once left me naked in a hotel room and taken my shoes because I'd called her by her sister's name. She looked down at my new keys.

speaker: MERCEDES
text: "You finally got a Mercedes you can afford, baby?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Come see it."

speaker: MERCEDES
text: "Nigga, you still owe me flowers."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I gave her five hundred out the money in my pocket.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Buy the whole fucking garden."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She kissed my cheek.

speaker: MERCEDES
text: "You bleeding on the good side of your face."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Both sides good, baby."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She laughed, and I left her with it. I was shining. I had a dead man's gold against my chest, a living man's keys in my hand, and no idea how much that shit could cost.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I had been with men and women all over that city. Big men who put their guns down gentle when they came into my room. Women who left lipstick on the champagne glasses and somebody else's diamonds on my pillow. I thought I knew every kind of trouble a beautiful person could bring into a room.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Then I saw Shawna.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She stood by the window with a cigarette in one hand and a silver case beside her ankle. She wore the same black dress from the picture. There was a little scar above her eyebrow. Somebody was talking to her, but she was looking straight at me.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I walked over. My mouth hurt, my ribs hurt, and every other woman I'd ever wanted fell clean out of my fucking head.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "T sent me."

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "I know."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "How?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: She looked at the cross on my chest.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Her cigarette stopped halfway to her mouth.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Where'd you get that?"

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Tonight?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Yeah."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She reached out and turned the cross over.

speaker: AIDEN
text: On the back were three little letters I hadn't noticed.

speaker: AIDEN
text: D. B. M.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Her fingers tightened around it.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "You know what those mean?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "No."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She let it fall against my shirt.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Drive before you find out."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I took the case. She took my hand. We walked through the party together while men who had been smiling a second earlier started reaching for their phones.

speaker: AIDEN
text: At the elevator, one of Red's guys stepped in front of us.

speaker: B01C02_RED_GUARD_1
text: "Nigga, where the fuck you taking her?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "With this nigga right here. You need my picture?"

speaker: B01C02_RED_GUARD_1
text: "Nigga, I'm asking her."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I hit him in the throat. He folded against the wall, and I shoved him down before he could get his hand inside his jacket. Shawna pressed the elevator button. The doors opened. Nigga was still looking at me like he couldn't believe I'd touched him. I stepped over his shoes.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Another man came around the corner.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She drew a little silver pistol from her purse and pointed it at his chest.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "You get one chance,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: she said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: He stopped.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The doors shut between us.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She didn't put the gun away until we reached the lobby.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I looked at her.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Niggas chasing you out of every party, or I got the special one?"

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Only the ones I survive."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I was already in love with her. I just didn't know how bad it was going to get.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The first car came after us before I had learned where the fucking seat warmer was.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Black Charger. No lights. Two men in it and a third leaning across the back seat with something long in his hands. Shawna saw them in her mirror before I did.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Aiden. Don't look."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Naturally I looked. Nigga, I had owned a Mercedes for eleven minutes. I was checking everything that got close to it.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The first shots came through the rear glass.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna dropped against the silver case. I ducked and the steering wheel jerked under my hands. We clipped a fountain with the right fender, threw white water over three gambling executives, and hit the street with the horn stuck screaming.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Your niggas?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I shouted.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "You think I'd ride with you if those were my niggas?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "You met me tonight!"

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "I'm trying to meet you tomorrow! Drive!"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I drove.

speaker: AIDEN
text: A yellow Ferrari came sideways out of the next street and joined the Charger. The man driving the Ferrari had an expression like he'd paid extra to kill somebody comfortably. He came level with my window and smiled while his passenger raised a pistol.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I looked at Shawna.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Baby, move your hand."

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "What?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "The horn."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She lifted her wrist. The screaming stopped. For one beautiful second all I could hear was that Ferrari and my own heart getting ready to become somebody's problem.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I turned toward the yellow car.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The passenger's face changed first. His gun went up. The driver tried to go with it. Yellow metal struck a street pole, and the Ferrari spun across a valet entrance spraying sparks over a hundred thousand dollars' worth of men's shoes.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Nigga!"

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "That's one."

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "That's a Ferrari!"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "That's one Ferrari. Keep up."

speaker: AIDEN
text: The Charger stayed on us. I could see the long gun moving behind its windshield. Then a red convertible shot out of a hotel drive between us, and Mercedes stood up in the passenger seat with her heels in one hand.

speaker: MERCEDES
text: "I told you about my fucking flowers, Aiden!"

speaker: AIDEN
text: Porsche was driving. Twenty-nine, dark red hair, red dress, eyes fixed on the road as if she had personally laid it. I'd met her once at a party where a rich man had bought her a sports car and cried when she actually drove away in it. She had kept both the car and his apology.

speaker: PORSCHE
text: "Sit down, Mercedes!"

speaker: AIDEN
text: she shouted.

speaker: MERCEDES
text: "He owes me!"

speaker: PORSCHE
text: "Nigga, he owes the whole street right now!"

speaker: AIDEN
text: Mercedes dropped as the red car swept across the Charger's nose. The black car braked hard enough to lift at the back. Shawna watched the women go by with her mouth open.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Your friends?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Good people."

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Your good people have terrible timing."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Look behind us."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She looked. The Charger was trying to pass Porsche. Porsche wouldn't let it. Every time its nose appeared, that red convertible slid over with her, carrying two furious beautiful women who had decided nobody was dying until their night got better.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna laughed once. It was the first happy sound I'd heard from her. It went through me harder than the gunshots.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Then the Charger hit their rear bumper.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Porsche's car swung. Mercedes grabbed the windshield frame. I saw her heels fly into the air, one silver shoe catching a streetlight before it disappeared into somebody's outdoor dinner.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I braked.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Aiden!"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Not leaving them."

speaker: AIDEN
text: The Charger filled my mirror. I could see the driver now, big white scar across his eyebrow, teeth showing as he tried to decide whether he wanted me or the women more.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, choose me,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I dropped behind the red car, and the Charger hit us instead.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Metal folded. My head struck the seat. Shawna's hand found my arm and held. The Mercedes kept rolling, its rear bumper screaming along the ground, and Porsche caught her car before it reached the wall. She lifted one finger without looking back. Not thank you. Something stronger.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The boulevard opened ahead. A transport truck crossed the intersection carrying a silver speedboat high above its cab. Beside it, the delivery ramp of a closed hotel pointed up toward a black ribbon of roof.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I looked at the ramp.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna looked at me.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "No."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "You don't know what I'm thinking."

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Nigga, I know exactly what you're thinking."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Then hold the case."

speaker: AIDEN
text: We hit the ramp so hard the sound disappeared.

speaker: AIDEN
text: My stomach went cold. The street fell below the windshield. For a second the whole fucking Strip lay under us, beautiful and useless, all those men spending their lives trying to buy a view while I flew through theirs with a woman on my arm and a three-million-dollar suitcase on her knees.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna screamed my name.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I would've stayed in the air forever to hear it like that.

speaker: AIDEN
text: We cleared the speedboat by less than the height of its flag. The Mercedes landed on the far side with a crash that drove my teeth together. A tire exploded. The car leaned, caught, kept moving. Behind us the Charger tried the same turn too late and went sideways into the truck's empty rear trailer.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I heard the collision through our broken windows.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna twisted around. A black wheel rolled through the intersection by itself.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The nigga wasn't following us anymore.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I slowed. My hands stayed steady on the wheel, though my whole chest was jumping. Porsche came alongside at the next light. Mercedes had one shoe left and looked ready to beat God with it.

speaker: PORSCHE
text: "You jumped a fucking boat!"

speaker: AIDEN
text: Porsche shouted.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Had to get over it somehow."

speaker: PORSCHE
text: "Aiden, nigga, you jumped the boat with a car!"

speaker: AIDEN
text: Behind her, a man on the sidewalk started clapping. Then the couple beside him. Then a whole row of people waiting for taxis, strangers putting down luggage to salute the greatest driver Vegas had ever fucking seen.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I lifted my hand.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna caught it and put it back on the wheel.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "They can admire you moving."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Mercedes pointed at her.

speaker: MERCEDES
text: "Keep him. He's expensive, but nigga, he comes with a show."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Porsche blew me a kiss and turned away, her convertible carrying one silver heel and two women who'd just made themselves family. I took us toward the desert on a damaged tire and the kind of pride a man could drive forever on.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna reached across and touched my cheek.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "You could've kept going when they hit those girls."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Wouldn't have been me."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She watched me another second. Then she put her hand on my leg and left it there.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Nigga, I could feel that hand all the way down to the tire.

speaker: AIDEN
text: We got out past the last casinos before she told me to pull over.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "T's house is farther out,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I said.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "I know where his fucking house is. Pull over."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I took the Mercedes off the road behind a shuttered wedding chapel. Half the sign was burned out. The parking lot was empty. Shawna opened the case on her lap.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Money filled it from one end to the other.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Three million,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: she said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I stared. Three million fucking dollars. That afternoon I'd been eating a gas-station sandwich in a borrowed car. Now this woman was opening a fortune in my Mercedes.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "T said—"

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "T says a lot."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She took an envelope from beneath the cash. Inside was a photograph, bent across the middle.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna stood in front of the same chapel, three years younger, wearing a white dress. A man stood beside her with his arms around her waist.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The cross on his neck was the one T had put on mine.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Dante,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: she said.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "His brother. My husband."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I looked from the photograph to her face. My nigga, I'd been carrying her dead husband against my chest and talking like the whole world started when I walked in.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She took the cigarette from behind her ear, tried to light it, and couldn't get the lighter to work.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I did it for her.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She watched the flame for a second before she leaned into it.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "I was twenty-three when I came out here. Thought I was going to sing. I had a suitcase, eight hundred dollars, and a number some girl gave me in Phoenix."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She looked out at the chapel.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "The number was Valentino's."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I knew the name. Everybody did. Valentino ran women through half the hotels on the Strip. He wore white suits and had a diamond in one of his teeth. Niggas laughed around him like he was funny. Women watched his hands.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "He bought me clothes. Got me a room. Told me he had people in music. By the time I knew what the fuck was happening, everything I had belonged to him."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She blew smoke against the windshield.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Dante came into the club on my birthday. Everybody else wanted something. He asked what kind of cake I liked."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Her mouth moved like she was going to smile.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She didn't.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "He came back with it the next night. Carrot cake. Whole fucking cake. Put it on the table between the bottles. Valentino laughed at him. Dante knocked out that diamond tooth."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "My nigga,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I said before I could stop myself.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "That's what I said."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She looked at the photograph.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "That's exactly what I fucking said."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She wiped one eye with her thumb, angry that she had to.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "We got married here six weeks later. T stood beside him. Red paid for the room. They all smiled in the pictures."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I looked at the gold cross in my hand.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "What happened?"

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Dante took money out of a deal. Three million. Told me we were going to leave. Said he had a brother, so he didn't have to be scared."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She turned the photograph over.

speaker: AIDEN
text: There was writing on the back.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Damn, boy. Magnificent.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "That's what the letters mean,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: she said.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Damn, boy. Magnificent. He looked in the chapel mirror after we got married and said it like God had just finished him. I laughed so hard I nearly dropped my flowers. Next morning I had it put on the cross."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga was right about you."

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "He was talking about himself."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I looked down at the gold against my chest.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Then the nigga finally got it on the right neck."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She laughed before she could stop herself. One bright, startled sound in the middle of all that hurt. She covered her mouth, still holding the photograph, and looked at me like I had just brought something she thought was gone into the car with us.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She held the photograph against her chest.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "They left him in the desert. Valentino brought me his watch. Told me Dante died begging for somebody to take care of me."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I wanted to kill a man I had never even met. Nigga was already dead, and I wanted another turn.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "What did you do?"

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Waited."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Her voice got quieter.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "For eight months, I waited. Valentino thought I came back because I had nowhere else to go. He thought I loved him by the end."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She looked straight at me.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Last Tuesday, I shot him in his car. He was talking when I did it. He kept talking after the first shot, so I shot him again. Then I took Dante's watch out of his glove compartment."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She showed me the watch on her wrist.

speaker: AIDEN
text: It was too big for her.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Red took me in. Said he'd protect me. Tonight I took the three million back."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "And T?"

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "T says he's going to get me out of Vegas."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I thought about the way he'd told me not to love her. Nigga knew what she was carrying besides the case.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I thought about the cross.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "You believe him?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I asked.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "I believed his brother."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She put the photograph inside her dress and closed the case.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Then she leaned across the seat and kissed me.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I forgot about the money. I forgot whose car I was driving. All I knew was her hand against my face and the taste of smoke on her mouth. When she pulled back, she was still holding on to me. My nigga, I could feel her trying to decide if I was another room she couldn't leave.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Don't take me to that house,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: she said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Then this nigga ain't taking you. Give me somewhere else."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Just like that. My first night in the family, and I was ready to go to war with every fucking one of them.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I took her to a motel outside town and paid for the whole top floor.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The clerk looked at the stack of money in my hand.

speaker: B01C02_MOTEL_CLERK
text: "All six rooms?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "All six. Nobody comes up."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Upstairs, Shawna put the case on the bed and her gun on the nightstand. I locked the door. We could hear trucks on the highway and somebody arguing with a woman in the parking lot below.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She unbuttoned my shirt to look at what Tank had done to my ribs.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Jesus, Aiden."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "I'm good."

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "You're bleeding."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "I've been bleeding all night."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She got a wet towel from the bathroom and cleaned my face. Every time she touched the cut on my mouth, she said she was sorry. Every time, I told her not to be.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I took off the cross and put it in her hand.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She started crying then. Hard. Like she'd been holding it in since the day somebody handed her that watch.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I held her. I didn't know anything worth saying to a woman who had carried that much pain into a room, so I just held her until she stopped shaking. Nigga, I was ready to threaten God for putting her through it. There wasn't anybody else left in the room to threaten.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Then she asked me to stay.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "I'm here, baby."

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Tonight. I mean tonight."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "I'm right fucking here."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She pulled me down to kiss her. I could taste salt at the edge of her mouth. All that blood and money downstairs, all those niggas looking for us, and she wanted my hands on her. I let the shirt fall off my shoulders. She shut the lamp off herself.

speaker: AIDEN
text: We spent the night together in that room with the money on the other bed and our guns within reach. Afterward, she lay against my chest while the blue light from the motel sign moved across the ceiling.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "What do you want?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: she asked.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "You."

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "You don't know me."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Then tell me more."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She told me about the songs she'd wanted to sing. About her mother in Phoenix, who thought she was working in a restaurant. About a house Dante wanted near the water, even though neither of them knew how to swim.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I told her we'd buy it.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I told her I'd take her anywhere she wanted.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I had known her less than three hours. I meant every fucking word. Give me a country and I would've put her name on it. Give me a year and I'd have fought every man in it to keep her.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Then my phone lit up.

speaker: AIDEN
text: T.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I let it ring.

speaker: AIDEN
text: A picture came through.

speaker: AIDEN
text: My Mercedes outside the motel.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Then a message.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Come down, son.

speaker: AIDEN
text: T stood beside the empty pool with Tank and two niggas I didn't know.

speaker: AIDEN
text: He wore the same shirt he'd been wearing when he brought me in. There was still a little of my blood on the cuff.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I came down the stairs with my hands where he could see them.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "Where's the money?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: he asked.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Upstairs."

speaker: BIG_T
text: "The girl?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Upstairs."

speaker: AIDEN
text: He nodded slowly.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "Nigga, one thing. I gave you one fucking thing to do."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "She told me about Dante."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank looked away.

speaker: AIDEN
text: T kept looking at me.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "Dante stole from his family."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, he was your brother."

speaker: BIG_T
text: "Then the nigga should've known better."

speaker: AIDEN
text: The words hit harder than the first punch.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I had wanted there to be something else. A lie. A misunderstanding. Some way he could say he hadn't done it and I could let myself believe him.

speaker: AIDEN
text: He didn't even try.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "That woman put him in the ground,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: T said.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "Now you standing here ready to follow him."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "You put him in the ground."

speaker: AIDEN
text: T stepped close.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "Nigga, who made you? Who put you in that car?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I could smell his cologne. The same cologne I'd smelled when he put the chain around my neck.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "I gave you money. A car. A fucking name in this city. You think she would've looked at you without all that?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I didn't answer.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "She's upstairs with my three million. That's what she's in love with."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Behind him, Tank shifted his weight.

speaker: AIDEN
text: T saw me notice.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "Last chance. Go get her."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Upstairs, a door opened.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna stood on the balcony holding the silver case.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "You want your money, T?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: He looked up.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She threw the case over the railing.

speaker: AIDEN
text: It hit the bottom of the empty swimming pool and burst open. Cash flew across the cracked blue tiles.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "There,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: she said.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Now tell him what I love."

speaker: AIDEN
text: T pulled his gun.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I hit his arm as he fired.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The shot shattered a window above us. Tank grabbed me from behind. One of T's men came in swinging, and I caught him with my forehead. My vision went red. I twisted free and drove Tank backward against the pool fence.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna fired from the balcony.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The man beside T went down.

speaker: AIDEN
text: T shoved his gun against my side.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I felt the shot before I heard it.

speaker: AIDEN
text: For a second, I couldn't breathe. I couldn't feel the ground. I had blood running under my shirt and T's face right in front of mine.

speaker: BIG_T
text: "Should've listened,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: he said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I grabbed his wrist with both hands and held on.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I wasn't letting that motherfucker point the gun at her. Nigga could empty it into me first.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank hit me again. I barely felt it. I drove my knee into T, tore one hand free, and got the pistol out of my waistband. My nigga, I loved him. Right up until that second, I still wanted him to let go.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I fired.

speaker: AIDEN
text: T fell against the fence.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I fired again.

speaker: AIDEN
text: He went down with his hand still reaching for me.

speaker: AIDEN
text: All the music in my head stopped.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank stared at him.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Then he looked at my gun.

speaker: TANK
text: "Aiden—"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, back—Tank, back the fuck up!"

speaker: AIDEN
text: He did.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna came down the stairs barefoot, still holding the little silver pistol. She saw the blood on my shirt and ran to me.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Baby. Oh, fuck. Baby, look at me."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I tried to tell her I was good.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Nothing came out.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She pressed both hands against my side and looked at Tank.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Get the fucking car!"

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank looked down at T one more time.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Then he went for the Mercedes.

speaker: AIDEN
text: That's how the west side became mine. With a dead father at my feet and another man's wife holding me together.

speaker: AIDEN
text: We left the money in the pool. All three million. Not a fucking dollar could've bought me another minute standing there.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna drove with one hand on the wheel and the other holding a towel against me. The sky was getting light over the desert. Behind us, Vegas kept shining like nothing had happened.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Stay with me,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: she kept saying.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "I'm here."

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Keep talking."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I told her about the house. About the water. About how we'd have a room just for her music. I told her we'd learn to swim. I said all that shit with blood in my mouth because she was crying again, and I couldn't stand it. Nigga, I was bleeding through a towel and promising waterfront property. She kept asking about the windows. I kept

speaker: AIDEN
text: telling her they'd face the sunrise.

speaker: AIDEN
text: At the edge of town, she pulled over long enough to put the gold cross back around my neck.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Don't,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "That's his."

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "I know."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She closed my fingers around it.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Then she kissed me and got back behind the wheel.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I watched the sun come up beside her face. My phone wouldn't stop ringing. T's people. Red's people. Niggas I'd never met calling to ask who was running things now.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I answered the third call.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Aiden,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: On the other end, somebody went quiet.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Then he said,

speaker: B01C02_CALLER
text: "What you want us to do?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I looked at Shawna.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She was watching the road, still wearing Dante's watch.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Some nigga better find me a doctor,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I said.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "And tell everybody the girl is with me."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Ten toes down. All the way to the end.
